title: Investigational New Drug Application (IND)
provenance: Official FDA secured PDF provided by the product owner (upload). Canonical source: fda.gov forms catalog.
note: This is the official FDA blank form. It is an Adobe LiveCycle DYNAMIC XFA form, so it cannot be reliably field-filled by the pdf-lib engine (0 AcroForm fields are exposed). The IND form service therefore renders a deterministic labeled data PDF (usedOfficialTemplate=false). To enable exact official-form filling, generate a static/flattened AcroForm edition with a reviewed canonical->AcroForm fieldMap, or fill via Adobe tooling; then set fillSupported/assetTrusted and populate fieldMap.
